steps.summary: Seed persisted collector state keys into AdapterState at resume so live state is populated and authoritative from the first instruction of a resumed leg.
Delete the Falcon findings resume recovery hook; reduce the assets resume hook to cursor re-anchoring only (no position/state restoration).
Rewrite the two enshrining continuation tests so the fixture carries live progress that diverges from WorkItem; fix the two resume-runner harness doubles.
Add a regression test proving a pre-publish deferral on a resumed leg preserves the persisted collector state, and that a post-publish deferral persists the advanced position.
Bump Infra package version, bump pinned Infra version in adapters, bump CollectorVersion.
